source_note: 以现存大成殿为主体，三张真实前面/前侧照片分别核立面、庑殿屋顶与御路月台，非文庙戟门或尊经阁。县官方规划定现存建筑为明清，按明代遗构配色，不按辽金寺庙创建年代着色。1472仅为全庙重建记录，未宣称为大成殿确切落成年。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER: use only its elegant very fine black contour lines, subtle organic variation, restrained detail and spacious white planes, not its Buddha shape.
Images 2, 3 and 4 are SUBJECT GEOMETRY: actual photographs of DACHENG HALL 大成殿, HUNYUAN CONFUCIAN TEMPLE 浑源文庙, Hunyuan, Shanxi. Image 2 is the actual FRONT FACADE, partly hidden by tree branches and with the roof partly cropped; use its FIVE-bay facade and door/window layout. Image 3 is the same hall in a complete SIDE-FRONT oblique view; use its correct complete HIP ROOF shape and height, deep projecting eaves, low platform and proportions. The large solid side wall in image3 must not replace the front doors from image2. Image 4 is the FRONT from farther away, behind two trees; use its front platform and small center ceremonial ramp, not its tree-obscured wall silhouette. Do NOT draw the neighbouring two-storey pavilion, gatehouse or background temple buildings.
Create a centered straight-on front elevation of this exact single hall. Preserve FIVE structural bays with SIX main front column axes, the THREE central sets of tall wood panel doors with narrow vertical lattice bars, and ONE blank masonry wall bay at each outer end. No extra doors in the end bays. Door lower halves have rectangular panel outlines. Preserve the wide shallow SINGLE-EAVE HIP ROOF 庑殿顶 with four sloping roof faces, no exposed gable triangles; the side photo clearly shows its hip form. Keep the pair of moderate curled ridge-end ornaments and the one slender small pagoda-like finial at the ridge center, plus only a few sparse small roof-ridge ornaments actually seen in the photo. Columns and dougong should look sturdy but drawn in delicate fine line. Keep the unusually simple open bracket arms rather than replacing them with ornate multi-tier Qing brackets. Preserve the shallow step immediately at the doors, plus the wider modest-height rectangular front platform visible in image4. At its center show a small sloping ceremonial ramp with just two or three sparse dragon-relief curves and shallow steps at either side, as actually visible. Do not make the platform disproportionately high or invent a huge grand staircase.
The actual hall is a surviving Ming-period building with earlier construction characteristics and later repairs. This is an architectural illustration of its present physical appearance, not a hypothetical original reconstruction. Remove tree branches, trees, courtyard railing, standalone stone steles, display boards, poles, neighbouring buildings, tourists and all writing. No giant characters or plaque. Keep verticals upright and use minimal perspective.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. Very fine confident outer contours and even finer selective internal lines. All surfaces and openings stay WHITE: no dark doorway fill. The roof is mostly blank white with only 10-14 widely spaced thin slope lines, no dense tile grid or brick courses. Suggest lattice with a few airy verticals, not heavy hatch. No thick ink, solid shadow, grey wash, hatching, crosshatching, engraving density, pencil grain, weathering texture, gradients, color or gold. No invented architectural features, lettering, watermark, captions, borders or frames.
Landscape 1536 x 1024. Complete hall centered occupying about 82 percent of canvas width, roof ridge, both eave tips and base uncut, generous balanced white margins. Only a few short ground lines. Match image1's calm clarity and delicate line weight.

historical_sources.publisher: 浑源县人民政府《浑源县国省保文物简介》
historical_sources.supports: 文庙在永安西街北侧、现存明清遗构。优先于个别旅游文案的金代或元代直接断代。
明成化八年1472全庙大规模重建、弘治四年1491扩充，2013年第七批国保，五间正面。该页误将万历三十九年写为1671，且屋顶称歇山与实拍四坡相冲突；这两点不采用。
大成殿现存明代、五间、单檐庑殿；前后立面、山面与门窗实拍交叉核对。

site_recommendation.lede: 浑源文庙的大成殿以五间立面承托宽阔屋顶，中央竖棂格扇与两侧砖墙相接。现存殿堂属于明代遗构，仍保留早期营造手法；御路龙纹石和殿后“忠孝节义”题刻，记录了这座州学的礼制功能。
facts: 官方资料记文庙在明成化八年（1472）大规模重建；现存建筑为明清遗构，大成殿精确落成年尚未核定。
大成殿面阔五间、单檐庑殿顶，前檐中央三间设格扇，左右两端为砖墙。
浑源文庙于2013年列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
